Name: Connor's Top Surgery Scars
Author: Aurekata
Description:
This mod will add subtle changes to your character's bathing suit sprites, regardless of which gender sprite you chose in the beginning! If you use the female sprite, it takes away the bikini and chest lumps away from the bathing suit. Guy model just adds some shading. This mod does not change anything outside of the bathing suit sprite because I don't even think you CAN take your shirt off without external mods that will add in their own sprites anyway. There's only one scar option because I don't know how to code in an option to choose which one you want (wasn't part of the tutorial I followed); I tried to make the scars DI, and able to be interpreted as either 2 separate scars or 1 long scar with a highlight in the middle. This mod doesn't add any nudity, just edits the occasional shirtless-ness that's already in the game.

I've never made a mod for any game before, I'm just a humble guy who knows how to use a pixel art editor. If this mod doesn't work for you, I have no idea how to fix it, good luck. I know the guy's sprite changes work, but I didn't even look to see if the "female" sprite works because all my saves are dudes. Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI. Heck yeah LGBT!

Edit: Less than a year after making this mod, I got my top surgery, and by complete coincidence, my scars look just like they do in this mod! (the gap between my scars is off-center to the center of my chest. thanks hEDS for scars stretching weirdly). I guess this mod was prophetic in a way. Hell yeah trans joy!!!
